reviewer: g4-breadth-c lane agent (real headless-Chrome first-visit download → inference route matrix, revision 1)

rubric.evidence: 15-minute probe BEFORE build: fresh headless Chrome (WASM, no-GPU) loaded onnx-community/phishing-email-detection-distilbert_v2.4.1-ONNX (text-classification, q8) via the exact shared CDN build @huggingface/transformers@3.7.5 and returned phishing LABEL_1 0.99995 on a credential-lure and LABEL_0 0.99999 on a benign work email (load 21.5s cold). Route validator then drove all 5 routes × desktop+mobile: overview auto-verdict PHISHING on the default lure with 4 class bars; practical triage 5 cleared / 5 flagged on WASM; wild original vs obfuscated both really scored (PHISHING vs PHISHING, drop −0.4 pts — homoglyph obfuscation only nudges this model, an honest finding); multi-model gate 5 kept / 3 junk + DistilBART digest.
rubric.notes: Inference runs off the main thread in models/phishing-email-detection/worker.js via loadPipeline (text-classification, q8).

rubric.evidence: The checkpoint emits FOUR logits (id2label LABEL_0..3); the model card maps 0=legitimate_email, 1=phishing, 2=legitimate_url, 3=phishing_url_alt. Worker calls top_k:4 and reports threat = P(LABEL_1)+P(LABEL_3), safe = 1−threat, plus all four raw class scores rendered as bars on overview + basics. Verified semantically: lures → PHISHING ≥0.99 threat, colleague/order messages → LEGITIMATE (Basics verdict-swing check PASS).
rubric.notes: classProbs() indexes by label so class ordering never matters; occlusion attribution is in threat log-odds.

rubric.evidence: At-a-glance table shows the exact ONNX id linked to its card, original weights cybersectony/phishing-email-detection-distilbert_v2.4.1, task text-classification, backend WebAssembly, quantisation q8, ~64 MB, Apache-2.0. Conformance suite generated: declares-model-id / declares-task / declares-backend / declares-quantisation / inference-off-main-thread.
rubric.notes: Worker uses new Worker + worker.js; no main-thread inference.

rubric.evidence: Shared lib/model-loader.js createModelLoader architecture: fresh-profile page-check showed state=download-required with a single 'Download model (~64 MB)' button and zero console errors; after download the overview auto-scored. Subsequent validator routes (same profile, cache present) auto-initialised with no Download click (only overview's firstVisit asserts the Download state; basics/wild/practical/multi-model went straight to ready).
rubric.notes: No hand-rolled Load button; per-model clear-cache via the shared loader.

rubric.evidence: live-status-region via role=status aria-live on #runStatus/#attrStatus/#status and the loader status; scoring/attribution/triage failures write to an .err status on the page. Console clean on every route at both viewports (validator hygiene: 0 console errors, 0 failed network requests × 10 route-viewports). WASM-only model — runs on the no-GPU runner, no WebGPU needed.
rubric.notes: Retry path provided by createModelLoader on failure; triage board fills progressively as per-item results land.

rubric.evidence: Overview: labelled textarea, 4 example chips, 'Explain the current message' occlusion button, loader Download/Clear. Basics: textarea + 4 chips incl. a look-alike-URL input. Practical: queue textarea, 'Triage queue', 'Load sample queue'. Wild: original textarea + 5 obfuscation checkboxes in a labelled fieldset. Multi-model: two loaders, gate + summarize buttons, digest-length range. All real, labelled, keyboard-operable; every control exercised by the validator.
rubric.notes: Occlusion runs N+1 batched forward passes in the worker; batch triage streams per-item.

rubric.evidence: Every visible verdict comes from the on-device pipeline: validator asserted the label/confidence/bars/attribution/triage/digest DOM values produced by real runs (e.g. triage status 'Done — 5 cleared, 5 flagged on WASM', gate {kept:5,junk:3}, digest >30 chars of generated text). No canned label strings in the source; sample messages are inputs, not outputs.

No content images (text-only family ⇒ no provenance ledger entries needed). Meter labels sit OUTSIDE the coloured bars with numeric values (WCAG AA); class names use design-system good/bad tokens paired with text labels (not colour alone). Live regions announce status. Attribution word chips carry a title with the exact log-odds.
rubric.notes: Verdict labels PHISHING/LEGITIMATE are text, never colour-only.

rubric.evidence: Validator hygiene at 1280×800 desktop AND 360×740 DPR3 mobile: no horizontal overflow on all 5 routes × both viewports (10/10 no-overflow PASS). Triage board + comparison panels use auto-fit minmax grids that collapse to one column on mobile; triage-text uses overflow-wrap:anywhere so long phishing URLs never overflow.

All inference (single classify, batch triage, N+1 occlusion) runs in a Web Worker; the main thread only renders small DOM updates. Typing debounced 350ms. Batch triage posts each result as it lands so a large paste fills progressively instead of blocking. q8 quant keeps the download at ~64 MB.
rubric.notes: break-up-long-tasks applied via the worker + progressive per-item posting.

guidanceConsulted.query: aria-live polite status announcements loading progress
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce status/errors in an accessible live region next to the action; label every control; keep colour paired with text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — role=status aria-live=polite on the run/attr/triage status lines and the loader status; failures add an .err class the user can read; PHISHING/LEGITIMATE badges pair colour with a text label.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: validator hygiene 0 console errors ×10 route-viewports; conformance live-status-region / errors-on-the-page assertions.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive grid cards without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid repeat(auto-fit, minmax()) for card/column rows; flexible tracks with min-inline-size:0; logical properties; avoid fixed widths that overflow narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — triage board and wild comparison panels use auto-fit minmax() grids collapsing to one column on mobile; class-bar rows use a fixed label column + flexible track; triage-text overflow-wrap:anywhere.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: no-overflow PASS on all 5 routes at 360×740 and 1280×800 in the validator.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive grid cards without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let components adapt to their own inline size rather than the viewport only.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — the auto-fit minmax(260px/220px,1fr) grids respond to the container's inline size (nested in panels and the steps layout), so the same board works inside narrow mobile panels and wide desktop panels without breakpoints.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: no-overflow PASS desktop + mobile across all routes.

guidanceConsulted.query: debounced text input live result region accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Associate labels with controls; group related toggles in a fieldset/legend; keep async result updates in a live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — textareas have wrapping <label>s; wild-page obfuscation toggles sit in a <fieldset> with a <legend>; multi-model digest-length range has a labelled live value read-out; verdicts update in aria-live regions.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: wild/index.html fieldset+legend; multi-model range with live val.

guidanceConsulted.query: aria-live polite status announcements loading progress
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Surface error feedback to screen-reader users at the point of interaction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied — scoring/attribution/triage/gate/summarize failures write a readable message into the adjacent role=status region with an .err class; loader failure states are announced by the shared loader's live region.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: errors-on-the-page conformance assertion; status regions in every route.

openQuestions: The wild route shows homoglyph/leet obfuscation only moves this model ~0.4 pts on a clear lure — a genuinely robust finding; worth probing zero-width + spacing combos on borderline text to find where it does break.

Class mapping comes from the model card's quick-start (LABEL_1=phishing, LABEL_3=phishing_url_alt); both are aggregated into threat. If upstream ever clarifies per-class semantics, the 4-bar display already exposes the raw scores.

followUpGoals.goal: Add a URL-only input mode that extracts and scores just the domain/link tokens (the card's URL classes) and contrasts them with full-email scoring.
Extend the wild lab with a normalisation toggle (strip homoglyphs/zero-width) showing the gateway-style pre-processing the page prose describes.

summary: Phishing email/URL detection (cybersectony DistilBERT, onnx-community ONNX, q8, WASM) built to the full family bar: overview with 4-class see-inside + occlusion attribution, live basics, reported-phish queue triage, an adversarial obfuscation lab, and a phish-gate→DistilBART-digest multi-model pipeline. All five routes verified with real inference at desktop + mobile, console/network clean.
